title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-oliver-chen-2026-03-18
content:
Morning check (8:30 AM)
- Quick wins: 2 warm replies in inbox (Acme / TonicHealth) — prioritize follow-up today.
- Main goals: 8 dials, 6 voicemails, 4 qualified conversations, 2 SQLs.
- Theme: emphasize latency/cost improvements for inference (Dedicated) + one-pager for private deployment.

Call list (priority order)
1) BrightMed - Luke Harris (DM) — 10:00 AM call
   - Notes: Healthcare startup, evaluating on-prem vs cloud for PHI. Interested in Private deployment.
   - Play: lead with private deployment + KMS/HSM compliance, offer docs + example arch diagram. Send one-pager after call.
   - Next action: call, ask SLA/throughput needs, propose intro to solutions eng.

2) VelocityApps - Priya Nair (CTO) — left voicemail yesterday
   - Notes: scaling generative features, complaining about token costs.
   - Play: Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles). Share cost-savings example (case study).
   - Email follow-up subject: "Quick idea to cut inference cost 30% for VelocityApps"

3) Orbit Retail - Sam Cole (Head of ML) — 11:30 AM
   - Notes: Currently using hosted API from large cloud vendor; interested in predictable latency for storefront features.
   - Play: showcase latency SLOs, dedicated pools. Ask about 95p latency targets and QPS.

4) Nova Analytics - inbound demo requested (lead)
   - Notes: demo scheduled Fri. Prep notes: focus on model catalog and rollout A/B features. Bring up streaming and function calls.

5) FrostBank - enterprise contact — follow-up on NDA + procurement
   - Notes: procurement requested SOC2 docs; legal loop started.
   - Action: escalate to AE and Customer Success to prep required compliance artifacts.

Quick outreach templates (short)
- Cold email (30-60 sec read):
  Subject: "Reduce inference latency/cost for <Company>"
  Hi <Name>,
  Quick note — we help teams reduce per-token cost and get predictable latency for customer-facing LLM features. If you're evaluating options for Dedicated or Private deployments, happy to send a short cost/latency comparison for your current setup.
  Would you be open to a 15-min call next week?
  — Oliver

- Follow-up after voicemail:
  Hi <Name>,
  I left a voicemail — wanted to share one quick stat: one customer cut token spend by ~28% after switching batching + prefix caching configs. If cost + latency are on your wishlist, I can share a tailored estimate.
  Cheers, Oliver

Pipeline notes (quick statuses)
- BrightMed: MQL -> demo interest -> high fit (PHI). Green.
- VelocityApps: cold inbound -> pain on cost. Send case study. Amber.
- Orbit Retail: researching latency -> ask for perf goals. Amber/green.
- Nova Analytics: hot inbound -> demo Fri. High priority.
- FrostBank: legal procurement -> blocked till SOC2 deliverable. Red.

Tasks / todo (today)
- [ ] Call BrightMed @10:00 (prep slides + 1-pager).
- [ ] Send VelocityApps cost case study + scheduling link.
- [ ] Confirm Orbit Retail QPS numbers (ask during call).
- [ ] Update demo deck for Nova (add rollout + canary slide).
- [ ] Ping CS for FrostBank SOC2 artifact (Slack message to Jenna).
- [ ] Log all calls in CRM + update stage (10-min rule).
- [ ] Add follow-up templates to outreach snippets doc (contribute after lunch).

Notes to self / reminders
- Keep call openers short: "Quick question — are you responsible for inference infrastructure decisions?"
- If they mention budget constraints, surface Dedicated reserved capacity benefits + predictable unit economics.
- Use Redwood Optimize examples (batching/caching) when customer cites high token spend.
- For private/procurement leads, pull together compliance packet: SOC2 + KMS integration note + on-prem deployment checklist.

End-of-day wrap (planned)
- Update CRM with outcomes.
- Draft follow-up emails for any non-responsive leads.
- Quick sync with AE on FrostBank (if needed).

Misc snippets (copyable lines)
- "We help teams keep latency tight while cutting per-token cost — here's a 2-pager with numbers."
- "Our dedicated pools give predictable p95s and fallback policies so your app stays online during spikes."
- "We can run a quick proof-of-concept in a week to validate latency + cost for your workload."

Open questions
- Who owns procurement at FrostBank? Need contact name.
- Orbit Retail: what percentile latency matters (p50/p95/p99)?
- BrightMed: expected data residency constraints (region/air-gapped)?

End of notes.
